svg.text: CONCEPTUAL DRAWING - not a screenshot of Regolith
Grown-up setup. Confirm every key in H Help.

g.text: 1. Save a career you want to keep. Do not overwrite it.
2. Open the Windows game yourself. Press H. Read Help.
3. Load or new career, then garage / drive, until a world shows.
Trust H if it disagrees with this card. This build was not drive-tested.
4. You handle menus. The child uses W A S D to look.
Esc menu | map button or Shift+M | Tab garage | Backspace may cost.
Do not use driving speed, jumps, or the little globe as science.
Skip Titan, Io, and Europa. Skip a site with no readable name.
Pause the 15-minute timer while you switch worlds.
